en.title: Turn inspiration into useful output
en.subtitle: A practical way to think about the video
items: Make one small thing that helps.
Ask its user what actually improved.
en.caption: An editorial way to apply the video’s create-more-than-you-consume idea; not a wealth formula.
en.alt: Turn inspiration into useful output. Learn: Choose a problem you understand. Build: Make one small thing that helps. Check: Ask its user what actually improved.
en.foot: Editorial guide, not a measured outcome.
